claude.sample_unit: annotated pediatric oncology notes (5,322 PHI spans)

links.outcome: Reference standard annotation gaps found by LLM outputs and re-annotation
links.effect: LLM outputs surfaced 414 candidate annotation gaps; re-annotation confirmed 227 PHI spans missing from the gold standard; recall against corrected standard 0.981.
links.quote: LLM outputs surfaced 414~candidate annotation gaps; re-annotation confirmed 227~PHI spans, against which the final prompt reached recall=0.981 (F1=0.907$\pm$0.002).

links.outcome: LLM F1 for de-identification compared with purpose-built systems on same notes
links.effect: Best LLM F1=0.918±0.001 vs. Stanford TiDE 0.779; advantages concentrated in contextual categories.
links.quote: LLMs outperformed the purpose-built systems (best F1=0.918$\pm$0.001 vs.\ TiDE 0.779), with advantages concentrated in contextual categories.

links.outcome: Recovery of missed institutional PHI after institution-specific prompt adaptation
links.effect: Naming the missed categories recovered 79% (48/61) of them; discouraging over-redaction restored precision.
links.quote: Naming the missed categories recovered 79\% (48/61) of them, and discouraging over-redaction restored precision.
